🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — September 18, 2026

Sun, in Virgo, holds a square to Moon, in Sagittarius. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Jupiter and Saturn hold a month-long trine underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, unsupported in Cancer. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Cardinal fire opens the account without argument. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Sun trines you from Virgo, and the ease asks its own attention. Fixed earth: nothing needs letting go of today. Venus has been out of Libra for four weeks now.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, moves through Libra unannounced. Sun in Virgo presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Air that changes shape, charged for each shape. Mercury has not been in Leo for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you and passes through Sagittarius as a guest. Sun in Virgo makes room for you, and then waits. Water begins, and beginning asks little today. The conjunction to Sun that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Virgo. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, meeting no resistance. Fire keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Two weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Libra, untitled. From Sagittarius, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. The hold Uranus had a week ago is not there any more.

♎ LIBRA
Venus, your ruler, is a foreigner in Scorpio and improvises. Moon sextiles you from Sagittarius: an opening to be reached for. Air moves first here, and first is enough. Saturn let go of it three weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you and is weak in Cancer: the grip tightens too soon. Sun sextiles you from Virgo: a door left ajar. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. A week ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon is with you, close enough to read the small print. Mutable fire: both answers turn out to be one answer. What pressed two weeks ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you from Aries, where it stands lowest. From Virgo, Sun makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Cardinal earth: beginning costs almost nothing. The square of a week ago is off it now.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. Moon in Sagittarius opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed air holds, and holding asks nothing back. Seven days ago none of this was in place.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Virgo, Sun returns your estimate with corrections. Mutable water: keeping options is the expense. This is days old, not weeks, and behaves like it.
